'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[September 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
***[[Lebanese displacement during the Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
****Over 22,000 [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] residents have crossed into [[Syria]] in order to escape ongoing [[Israel]]i bombardment and a potential escalation of the conflict. [https://www.barrons.com/news/more-than-22-000-people-cross-to-syria-amid-israeli-strikes-on-lebanon-syria-security-sources-eefb1e98 (''Barron's'')]
***Two people, including Mohammad Hussein Srour, a senior commander in [[Hezbollah]], are killed and 15 others are injured in an Israeli [[airstrike]] in [[Beirut]], Lebanon. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/26/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-72-killed-in-latest-wave-of-israeli-attacks (Al Jazeera)]
***At least 92 people are killed and 153 others are injured in airstrikes across Lebanon, bringing the total death toll from the airstrikes to more than 700 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/26/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-72-killed-in-latest-wave-of-israeli-attacks?update=3205303 (Al Jazeera)]
**Israel rejects proposals from the [[United States]], [[Australia]], and the [[European Union]] to initiate a temporary 21-day [[ceasefire]] with Hezbollah. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanese-prime-minister-believes-ceasefire-between-israel-hezbollah-possible-2024-09-26/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-says-it-launched-rocket-targeting-mossad-base-near-tel-aviv-2024-09-25/ (Reuters 2)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Russian Defense Ministry]] claims that [[Russian forces]] have taken the city of [[Ukrainsk]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/09/26/russian-army-says-captured-town-in-ukraines-donetsk-region-a86484 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Prior to a meeting with [[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]], [[U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces a [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|military aid package]] of more than $8 billion for [[Ukraine]] and directs [[The Pentagon]] to allocate all remaining [[United States federal budget|security funds]] to Ukraine by the end of his presidential term in January 2025. [https://www.reuters.com/world/biden-announces-8-billion-military-aid-ukraine-2024-09-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war]]
***The United States grants Israel a $8.7 billion [[List of military aid to Israel during the Israel–Hamas war|military aid package]], with [[U.S. Secretary of Defense]] [[Lloyd Austin]] stating that the U.S. will not change its commitment to providing military aid to Israel. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/risk-all-out-war-between-hezbollah-israel-pentagon-chief-2024-09-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Eight [[Pakistani Taliban]] militants are killed in a [[shootout]] with [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] in [[North Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-security-forces-militants-killed-3831bb21ebc34e3db68f73737957c027 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Helene (2024)|Hurricane Helene]]
***Hurricane Helene makes landfall in [[Florida]], [[United States]], as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category 4]] hurricane, with sustained winds of {{cvt|140|mph|km/h}} and a minimum central pressure of 938 [[millibar]]s. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCUAT4+shtml/270319.shtml? (National Hurricane Center)]
***[[Tropical storm]] conditions occur across western Florida, with an automated weather station recording sustained winds of {{cvt|54|mph|km/h}} with gusts up to {{cvt|68|mph|km/h}} near [[Tampa Bay]]. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2024/al09/al092024.update.09261955.shtml? (National Hurricane Center)]
*[[2024 India floods]]
**[[2024 Jivitputrika tragedy]]
***At least 46 people, including 37 children, who were taking part in [[Jitiya|Jivitputrika]] festivities in [[Bihar]], [[India]], drown in rivers and bodies of water swollen by ongoing flooding across India. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/dozens-children-drown-during-hindu-festival-india-2024-09-26/ (Reuters)]
**Up to {{conv|275|mm|in|abbr=on}} of rain falls across [[Mumbai]], [[India]], causing at least four deaths. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/09/26/heavy-rains-paralyze-mumbai-at-least-four-dead- (Al Arabiya)]
*A bus crashes into a [[river]] in [[Wolayita Zone|Wolaita]], [[Ethiopia]], killing 28 people and wounding 19 more. [https://www.barrons.com/news/ethiopia-bus-accident-kills-at-least-28-officials-4d456966 (''Barron's'')]
*A [[United States]] defence official claims that a [[China|Chinese]] [[nuclear submarine|nuclear]] [[attack submarine]], the first of the new Zhou-class, likely sank during construction earlier this year. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/new-chinese-nuclear-attack-submarine-sank-construction-us-114217903 (ABC News)]
